name: 5th Health Economics Conference (TSE-CEPR)
organizer: CEPR and TSE Health Center (Toulouse School of Economics); organising committee Angélique Acquatella, Pierre Dubois, Jean Tirole
venue: Toulouse School of Economics, Auditorium A3 Jean-Jacques Laffont & Auditorium A4, 1 Esplanade de l'Université
deadline_note: Stated as 'Date limite de soumission des articles : 16 février 2027.' The page body still contains text carried over from the 2026 (4th) edition.
submission_requirements: Paper submission via the TSE call-for-papers link. Topics include financing of innovation, R&D, patents, access to care, pharmaceutical market regulation, clinical trial regulation, reference pricing, precision medicine, telemedicine and digital technologies.
registration_fee: Participants cover their own travel; the conference covers coffee breaks, lunches and dinners. Unfunded junior researchers may apply for CEPR travel and accommodation support at submission.
keynotes: Amanda Starc (Northwestern University); Jonathan Kolstad (UC Berkeley)
